intro: 正弦稳态下，同一频率的电压电流只差在**大小和相位**，把它们用复数（相量）表示，微分方程就变成了复数代数方程，KCL、KVL 和元件关系都照样成立。本课程一律以 **cos** 为参考函数，相量默认取**有效值**。

en.intro: In sinusoidal steady state all voltages and currents share one frequency and differ only in **magnitude and phase**. Represent them by complex numbers (phasors) and the differential equations become complex algebra; KCL, KVL and the element relations all still hold. This course always uses **cosine** as the reference function, and phasors are **rms** phasors by default.

ideas.title: 正弦量的三要素
text: v(t) = V_m cos(ωt + ψ_v)：**幅值** V_m、**角频率** ω（rad/s）、**初相** ψ_v（t = 0 时的相位，取 |ψ| ≤ 180°）。三者确定一个正弦量。
ω = 2πf = 2π/T：工频 f = 50 Hz 时 ω = 100π ≈ 314 rad/s，T = 20 ms。读题时先从表达式里把三要素读出来。

en.title: The three elements of a sinusoid
text: v(t) = V_m cos(ωt + ψ_v): **amplitude** V_m, **angular frequency** ω (rad/s) and **initial phase** ψ_v (the phase at t = 0, taken with |ψ| ≤ 180°). These three fix a sinusoid.
ω = 2πf = 2π/T: at mains frequency f = 50 Hz, ω = 100π ≈ 314 rad/s and T = 20 ms. Read the three elements off the expression first.

ideas.title: 有效值
text: 有效值是“热效应相同的直流值”：I = √(\frac{1}{T}∫_{0}^{T}i^{2}dt)。对正弦量 I = I_m/√2 ≈ 0.707I_m。
电表的读数、铭牌上的 220 V 都是有效值。v = 220√2 cos(100πt) V 的有效值是 220 V，幅值约 311 V。

en.title: RMS values
text: The rms value is the DC value with the same heating effect: I = √(\frac{1}{T}∫_{0}^{T}i^{2}dt). For a sinusoid I = I_m/√2 ≈ 0.707I_m.
Meter readings and the 220 V on a nameplate are rms values. v = 220√2 cos(100πt) V has rms value 220 V and amplitude about 311 V.

ideas.title: 相位差：超前与滞后
text: 两个**同频率**正弦量的相位差等于初相之差：φ = ψ_v − ψ_i，与时间无关，取 |φ| ≤ 180°。
φ > 0：v **超前** i（v 先到达最大值）；φ < 0：v 滞后 i；φ = 0 同相；φ = ±180° 反相；φ = ±90° 正交。
比较相位前两个量必须用同一种函数（都化成 cos）、同样的符号形式（系数为正）。

en.title: Phase difference: leading and lagging
text: The phase difference of two sinusoids of the **same frequency** is the difference of their initial phases: φ = ψ_v − ψ_i, independent of time, taken with |φ| ≤ 180°.
φ > 0: v **leads** i (v reaches its maximum first); φ < 0: v lags i; φ = 0 in phase; φ = ±180° in antiphase; φ = ±90° in quadrature.
Before comparing, write both with the same function (cosine) and a positive coefficient.

ideas.title: 正弦量与相量的互换
text: v(t) = √2V cos(ωt + ψ_v) ↔ **有效值相量** V̇ = V∠ψ_v。相量只记有效值和初相，ω 是全电路共同的，不写进相量。振幅相量 V̇_m = V_m∠ψ_v = √2V̇。
给出 sin 形式时先化为 cos：sin x = cos(x − 90°)；负号化为 ±180°：−cos x = cos(x ± 180°)、−sin x = cos(x + 90°)。
相量是复数，不等于正弦量：只能写 v(t) ↔ V̇，不能写 v(t) = V̇。求得相量后，按同样的规则写回时域。

en.title: From sinusoid to phasor and back
text: v(t) = √2V cos(ωt + ψ_v) ↔ **rms phasor** V̇ = V∠ψ_v. The phasor keeps only the rms value and the initial phase; ω is common to the whole circuit and not part of it. The amplitude phasor is V̇_m = V_m∠ψ_v = √2V̇.
Convert a sine to a cosine first: sin x = cos(x − 90°); turn a minus sign into ±180°: −cos x = cos(x ± 180°), −sin x = cos(x + 90°).
A phasor is a complex number, not the sinusoid: write v(t) ↔ V̇, never v(t) = V̇. Once a phasor is found, convert it back to the time domain by the same rule.

ideas.title: 复数运算：代数形式与极坐标形式
text: 代数形式 A = a + jb，极坐标形式 A = |A|∠θ，|A| = √(a² + b²)，θ = arctan(b/a)（注意按 a、b 的符号判断象限）。
**加减用代数形式**（实部、虚部分别相加），**乘除用极坐标形式**（模相乘除、辐角相加减）。乘以 j = 1∠90° 相当于逆时针转 90°，乘以 −j 顺时针转 90°。

en.title: Complex arithmetic: rectangular and polar forms
text: Rectangular form A = a + jb, polar form A = |A|∠θ, with |A| = √(a² + b²) and θ = arctan(b/a) (pick the quadrant from the signs of a and b).

**Add and subtract in rectangular form** (real and imaginary parts separately), **multiply and divide in polar form** (magnitudes multiply/divide, angles add/subtract). Multiplying by j = 1∠90° rotates by +90° (counter-clockwise), by −j by −90°.

ideas.title: R、L、C 元件的相量关系
text: 关联参考方向下：电阻 V̇ = Rİ，电压电流**同相**；电感 V̇ = jωLİ = jX_Lİ，电压**超前**电流 90°；电容 V̇ = \frac{1}{jωC}İ = −jX_Cİ，电流**超前**电压 90°。
感抗 X_L = ωL 随频率升高而增大，容抗 X_C = 1/(ωC) 随频率升高而减小，单位都是 Ω。有效值关系 V = X_LI、V = X_CI 只给大小，相位要另外记。
来源：时域的 d/dt 对应相量的乘以 jω，所以 v = L di/dt ↔ V̇ = jωLİ，i = C dv/dt ↔ İ = jωCV̇。

en.title: Phasor relations of R, L and C
text: With the passive sign convention: resistor V̇ = Rİ, voltage and current **in phase**; inductor V̇ = jωLİ = jX_Lİ, voltage **leads** current by 90°; capacitor V̇ = \frac{1}{jωC}İ = −jX_Cİ, current **leads** voltage by 90°.

The inductive reactance X_L = ωL grows with frequency, the capacitive reactance X_C = 1/(ωC) falls with frequency; both are in Ω. The rms relations V = X_LI, V = X_CI give only magnitudes; remember the phases separately.
Why: d/dt in the time domain becomes multiplication by jω for phasors, so v = L di/dt ↔ V̇ = jωLİ and i = C dv/dt ↔ İ = jωCV̇.

ideas.title: 相量形式的 KCL、KVL：有效值不能直接相加
text: 同频正弦量之和仍是同频正弦量，所以 Σi = 0 ↔ Σİ = 0，Σv = 0 ↔ ΣV̇ = 0：基尔霍夫定律对**相量**成立。
**有效值一般不满足 KCL、KVL**：3 A 与 4 A 相差 90° 的两个电流之和是 5 A，不是 7 A；RLC 串联中电感、电容上的电压可以比电源电压还大。电表读的是有效值，合成时要用相量（或相量图）。

en.title: KCL and KVL for phasors: rms values do not add
text: The sum of same-frequency sinusoids is a sinusoid of that frequency, so Σi = 0 ↔ Σİ = 0 and Σv = 0 ↔ ΣV̇ = 0: Kirchhoff's laws hold for **phasors**.

**RMS values generally do not obey KCL or KVL**: 3 A and 4 A in quadrature add to 5 A, not 7 A; in a series RLC circuit the inductor or capacitor voltage can exceed the source voltage. Meters read rms values; combine them as phasors (or with a phasor diagram).

ideas.title: 相量图
text: 把相量画在复平面上：长度 = 有效值，方向 = 初相。KCL、KVL 变成相量的首尾相接。
选**参考相量**：串联电路选电流（各元件共用），并联电路选电压。R 上的电压与电流平行，L、C 上的电压与电流垂直，于是常常出现直角三角形，用勾股定理、三角函数就能由电表读数反推参数（三电压表法、同相条件等）。
只知道有效值时，相量图往往是最快的方法：先画已知方向的相量，再用长度条件把三角形画全。

en.title: Phasor diagrams
text: Draw the phasors in the complex plane: length = rms value, direction = initial phase. KCL and KVL become phasors placed head to tail.

Choose a **reference phasor**: the current for a series circuit (common to all elements), the voltage for a parallel one. The voltage of R is parallel to its current and those of L and C are perpendicular to theirs, so right triangles appear everywhere; Pythagoras and trigonometry then recover parameters from meter readings (three-voltmeter method, in-phase conditions, …).
When only rms values are known, the diagram is often the fastest method: draw the phasors whose directions you know, then complete the triangle from the lengths.

formulas.name: 正弦量
formulas.when: 以 cos 为参考函数；初相取 |ψ_v| ≤ 180°。

en.name: Sinusoid
en.when: Cosine reference; initial phase taken with |ψ_v| ≤ 180°.

formulas.name: 有效值
formulas.when: 只对正弦量成立（一般周期量用 √(平均的平方) 定义）。

en.name: RMS value
en.when: Sinusoids only (other periodic signals: square root of the mean of the square).

formulas.name: 相位差
formulas.when: 两个同频率正弦量，同为 cos、系数为正；φ > 0 表示 v 超前 i，取 |φ| ≤ 180°。

en.name: Phase difference
en.when: Two sinusoids of the same frequency, both cosines with positive coefficients; φ > 0 means v leads i; |φ| ≤ 180°.

formulas.name: 有效值相量
formulas.expr: v = \sqrt{2}V cos(ωt + ψ_v) ↔ V̇ = V∠ψ_v = V cos ψ_v + jU sin ψ_v
formulas.when: 同一频率的正弦稳态量；振幅相量 V̇_m = √2V̇。

en.name: RMS phasor
en.expr: v = \sqrt{2}V cos(ωt + ψ_v) ↔ V̇ = V∠ψ_v = V cos ψ_v + jU sin ψ_v
en.when: Sinusoidal steady-state quantities of one frequency; the amplitude phasor is V̇_m = √2V̇.

formulas.name: 化为 cos
formulas.expr: sin x = cos(x − 90°)，−cos x = cos(x ± 180°)，−sin x = cos(x + 90°)
formulas.when: 写相量之前先把表达式化成系数为正的 cos 形式。

en.name: Convert to cosine
en.expr: sin x = cos(x − 90°), −cos x = cos(x ± 180°), −sin x = cos(x + 90°)
en.when: Before writing a phasor, bring the expression to a cosine with a positive coefficient.

formulas.name: 复数乘除
formulas.when: 加减用代数形式；由 a + jb 求辐角时按象限判断，不能只看 arctan(b/a)。

en.name: Complex multiply/divide
en.when: Add and subtract in rectangular form; when finding the angle of a + jb, check the quadrant — arctan(b/a) alone is not enough.

formulas.name: 元件 VCR
formulas.when: v、i 关联参考方向；X_L = ωL，X_C = 1/(ωC)，均为正值（Ω）。

en.name: Element VCRs
en.expr: V̇_R = Rİ; V̇_L = jωLİ = jX_Lİ; V̇_C = \frac{1}{jωC}İ = −jX_Cİ
en.when: v and i associated; X_L = ωL and X_C = 1/(ωC) are both positive (Ω).

formulas.name: 相量形式的 KCL、KVL
formulas.when: 所有量同一频率；对有效值一般**不**成立。

en.name: Phasor KCL, KVL
en.when: All quantities at one frequency; generally **not** true for rms values.

examples.title: RL 串联：相量计算与电压表读数
examples.statement: 图示 RL 串联电路接 v_s(t) = 20√2 cos(1000t) V，R = 6 Ω，L = 8 mH。求电流相量 İ（代数形式和极坐标形式）、R 和 L 上电压的有效值和初相，写出 i(t)，并说明为什么两个电压有效值之和不等于电源电压。
steps: 6. **为什么 12 + 16 ≠ 20？** V̇_R 与 V̇_L 相差 90°，相量相加：√(12² + 16²) = 20，正好是 V_s。电压表读数（有效值）不满足 KVL，相量才满足。

en.title: Series RL: phasor arithmetic and voltmeter readings
en.statement: A series RL circuit is driven by v_s(t) = 20√2 cos(1000t) V, with R = 6 Ω and L = 8 mH. Find the current phasor İ (rectangular and polar), the rms values and initial phases of the voltages across R and L, write i(t), and explain why the two rms voltages do not add up to the source voltage.
steps: 2. **Element relations.** X_L = ωL = 1000 × 0.008 = 8 (Ω). KVL: V̇_s = Rİ + jX_Lİ = (6 + j8)İ.
5. **Phase relation.** φ = ψ_v − ψ_i = 0° − (−53.13°) = 53.13° > 0: v_s leads i, the circuit is inductive.
6. **Why 12 + 16 ≠ 20?** V̇_R and V̇_L are 90° apart; as phasors they add to √(12² + 16²) = 20, exactly V_s. Voltmeter readings (rms values) do not obey KVL; phasors do.

examples.title: RC 并联：电流表读数与相量图
examples.statement: 图示电路中 V̇_s = 24∠0° V（有效值），ω = 1000 rad/s，R = 8 Ω，C = 125 µF。电流表 A_1、A_2 分别测 R、C 支路电流，A 测总电流。求三个电流表的读数和总电流的初相。
steps: 1. **并联电路选电压为参考相量：** V̇_s = 24∠0° V，两条支路电压相同。
3. **相量形式的 KCL。** İ = İ_R + İ_C = 3 + j3 = 3√2∠45°：A 读 **4.243 A**，初相 **45°**——总电流超前电压，电路呈容性。
4. **相量图。** İ_R 沿实轴、İ_C 沿虚轴，两者组成等腰直角三角形，斜边 3√2。读数 3 + 3 = 6 ≠ 4.243：有效值不满足 KCL。

en.title: Parallel RC: ammeter readings and the phasor diagram
en.statement: V̇_s = 24∠0° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s, R = 8 Ω, C = 125 µF. Ammeters A_1 and A_2 measure the R and C branch currents, A the total current. Find the three readings and the initial phase of the total current.

results.ask: initial phase of the total current

steps: 1. **Parallel circuit, so take the voltage as reference:** V̇_s = 24∠0° V across both branches.

2. **Branch currents.** İ_R = V̇_s/R = 24/8 = 3∠0°, A_1 reads **3 A**. X_C = 1/(ωC) = 1/(1000 × 125×10⁻⁶) = 8 (Ω), İ_C = V̇_s/(−j8) = j3 = 3∠90°, A_2 reads **3 A** (the capacitor current leads the voltage by 90°).
3. **Phasor KCL.** İ = İ_R + İ_C = 3 + j3 = 3√2∠45°: A reads **4.243 A**, initial phase **45°** — the total current leads the voltage, the circuit is capacitive.
4. **Phasor diagram.** İ_R lies on the real axis and İ_C on the imaginary axis; they form an isosceles right triangle with hypotenuse 3√2. The readings 3 + 3 = 6 ≠ 4.243: rms values do not obey KCL.

mistakes.text: 把电表读数（有效值）直接相加减来用 KCL、KVL。只有相量（或瞬时值）满足基尔霍夫定律；有效值要按相量图合成。

en.text: Adding meter readings (rms values) directly in KCL or KVL. Only phasors (or instantaneous values) obey Kirchhoff's laws; combine rms values with a phasor diagram.

mistakes.text: sin 形式的正弦量直接拿初相写相量（把 10√2 sin(ωt + 60°) 写成 10∠60°）。先化为 cos：10√2 cos(ωt − 30°) → 10∠−30°。

en.text: Reading the phasor angle straight off a sine (writing 10√2 sin(ωt + 60°) as 10∠60°). Convert to cosine first: 10√2 cos(ωt − 30°) → 10∠−30°.

mistakes.text: 幅值与有效值混用：v = 100√2 cos ωt 的有效值相量是 100∠0°，不是 100√2∠0°。写回时域时也别忘了乘 √2。

en.text: Mixing amplitude and rms: the rms phasor of v = 100√2 cos ωt is 100∠0°, not 100√2∠0°. Remember the √2 when converting back to the time domain.

mistakes.text: 电容写成 V̇ = jX_Cİ。电容是 −jX_C（电流超前电压），电感才是 +jX_L（电压超前电流）。

en.text: Writing V̇ = jX_Cİ for a capacitor. A capacitor is −jX_C (current leads voltage); +jX_L belongs to the inductor (voltage leads current).

mistakes.text: 写成 v(t) = 10∠30° V。相量与正弦量是对应关系（↔），不是相等。

en.text: Writing v(t) = 10∠30° V. A phasor corresponds to a sinusoid (↔); it is not equal to it.

mistakes.text: 用 arctan(b/a) 求辐角时不看象限：−3 − j4 的辐角是 −126.87°，不是 53.13°。

en.text: Taking the angle as arctan(b/a) without checking the quadrant: the angle of −3 − j4 is −126.87°, not 53.13°.
